messages:
jess (Docs): opened PR for migration guide + SDK examples (rotating creds, new client pattern). preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr/823 — tagging @hugo @meera for sensitive content review. CI pending.

hugo (Security): quick skim: there's a partner callback URL `https://partners.internal.red/ingest` and a sample API key `sk-live-12345` in examples. we need to redact partner hostnames and replace keys with env placeholders. also request a DLP and secret-scan.

jess (Docs): thanks. replaced host with `https://<PARTNER_HOST>/ingest` and keys with `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY`. pushed. requesting scans.

pr-bot: secret-scan queued for PR 823 -> completed: found 1 match: `sk-live-12345` in examples/rotate.js line 8.

jess (Docs): argh, missed one in a code block. patched to `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and pushed.

pr-bot: dlp-scan started for PR 823 -> completed: no high-risk issues, flagged external partner doc link `https://partnerdocs.example.com/rotate` which requires NDA to access.

meera (Legal): we can't link to NDA-only partner docs in public docs. either remove the link or add a short note and point to an internal mirror that Legal can host. i can coordinate with Partnerships for a sanitized version.

jess (Docs): removing external partner link for now and replacing with: "See Partner rotation guidance (contact Partnerships)". added frontmatter: `sensitive: true` and `audit-log: true` so publishing is gated and audit recorded. pushed.

hugo (Security): approve after the scans and placeholders; one more ask: add an example YAML frontmatter snippet showing `sensitive: true` and `redaction: requested` so our docs pipeline surfaces it in the redaction queue.

jess (Docs): added `redaction: requested` to frontmatter. updated the preview. re-run CI.

pr-bot: ci/docs-preview: failed -> reason: broken import in sample code: `import { Redwood } from 'redwood-client/v1'` not found.

sam (Platform): tagging SDK owners — the right import is `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/sdk'`. Jess, you can either update code sample or add a compatibility note.

jess (Docs): updated samples to the correct import and switched snippets to `RedwoodClient.fromEnv()` pattern. pushed.

pr-bot: ci/docs-preview: success -> preview URL https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-823/migration-guide-rotate

hugo (Security): re-reviewed. secret-scan & dlp clean, placeholders present, `sensitive: true` + `redaction: requested` in frontmatter. Security signoff: approved.

meera (Legal): Legal approved pending Partnerships sanitized doc. approved language for data handling: "Do not reference restricted partner materials in public docs. Contact Partnerships for approved excerpts." Leaving a small editorial nit in a PR comment.

jess (Docs): merging after Legal ok. planning to keep this page gated from public publish until Partnerships provides sanitized partner guidance. merging now.

pr-bot: merge complete -> Merge pull request #823 from docs/migrate-rotate-sdk -> commit b7e4f2.

sam (Platform): noted. Platform will block public publish for pages with `sensitive: true` until Partnerships supplies the sanitized partner doc. keeping preview live for audits.

jess (Docs): thanks team — saved preview + audit metadata to docs-audit. will follow up in #partnerships for the sanitized reference.
